traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria and requirements for 021.0-DEV-TEST-ANNOTATION-AUTO-FIX are fully implemented and verified.
- File-level template: Implemented by buildSupportsTemplateComment/insertSupportsTemplate and ensureFileSupportsAnnotation; tests confirm the exact placeholder JSDoc (including TODO line) is inserted at the top of test files missing @supports. - Format fixes: normalizeReqPrefixInDescription and normalizeReqId implement safe normalization of malformed REQ prefixes (spacing, underscores, parentheses, case); tests cover all example shapes from the story. - Safety and preservation: Auto-fixes only touch comments and test name string literals; helper JSDoc and logic avoid inferring new IDs or modifying implementation code, satisfying REQ-TEST-FIX-SAFE, REQ-TEST-FIX-PRESERVE, and REQ-TEST-FIX-NO-INFERENCE. - Integration and UX: Rule meta.fixable is set, behavior is wired into ESLint --fix via context.report fixers, configuration options match the story, and user-docs/api-reference.md documents the auto-fix behavior and options for end users. - Tests: Dedicated RuleTester cases validate both diagnostics and before/after auto-fix behavior for templates and prefix normalization, and the full Jest suite passes.
Given unchanged story requirements and all relevant tests currently passing, this story is assessed as PASSED.
